title: Runtime Semantic Contract Execution
flow: upstream semantic reasoning authority -> SemanticDataflowReasoningAuthorityInterface -> runtime adapter -> DataFlowAuthorityInterface -> downstream consumers

results.name: upstream declares an executable semantic-dataflow reasoning contract
results.detail: Runtime code depends on a domain-specific contract composed from the shared typed judgment interface, not a concrete closure implementation.

results.name: upstream authority binds the contract to the canonical judgment constructor
results.detail: The existing semantic closure solver remains the sole implementation behind the contract.

results.name: runtime adapter receives authority through dependency wiring
results.detail: The adapter executes the upstream contract and does not own semantic reasoning.

results.name: runtime exposes the closed authority contract, not producer execution methods
results.detail: A closed judgment crosses the boundary without fake seed/derive/close execution methods.

results.name: runtime adapter has no direct solver dependency
results.detail: The wiring layer cannot call the concrete semantic closure constructor directly.

results.name: composition injects the canonical upstream authority
results.detail: The production composition is the explicit binding point between upstream authority and runtime execution.

results.name: runtime boundary preserves the closed dataflow authority contract
results.detail: The runtime receives a read-only state/query surface with explicit wiring direction.

results.name: legacy AST analyzer uses the same reasoning contract
results.detail: The deprecated compatibility facade no longer bypasses the authority contract.

results.name: semantic result interface remains a projection over a closed judgment
results.detail: The result interface does not introduce a second solver or duplicate the judgment ADT.

results.name: operation identity contract remains upstream-owned
results.detail: Operation identity still flows through the upstream contract, algebra, and authority.

results.name: operation identity algebra preserves reasoning evidence
results.detail: Runtime contract changes do not discard identity proof, provenance, or derivation.

results.name: operation identity wiring projects rather than reconstructs
results.detail: CLI projection continues consuming the closed upstream capability.

results.name: AST dataflow contract aliases canonical semantic ADTs
results.detail: AST and dataflow retain distinct roles while sharing canonical typed evidence/judgment.

results.name: generic dataflow separates producer execution from read-only consumer authority
results.detail: The public generic contract retains explicit execution and authority facets.

results.name: React and SDK remain downstream consumers of closed capabilities
results.detail: React hook selection and SDK operation identity remain fail-closed consumers.

results.name: manifest projection forwards canonical upstream dataflow inputs
results.detail: Manifest projection forwards typed input evidence and does not run semantic closure.

results.name: IR projects the closed authority state without reconstructing closure
results.detail: IR is a projection of closed upstream state, not another semantic solver.

results.name: structural graph consumes semantic relations through graph-edge projection
results.detail: Graph topology is projected from structural semantic relations through the typed edge contract.

results.name: SDK schema mapper consumes upstream parser contract and mapper boundary
results.detail: Schema parsing and mapping stay at the SDK boundary; they do not reclassify upstream semantic capability.

results.name: SDK query key derives from upstream operation identity
results.detail: Endpoint identity is required upstream and then used as the stable query-key seed.

results.name: React TanStack Query consumes the SDK query key
results.detail: React does not independently reconstruct endpoint identity or query semantics.

results.name: Axios remains the HTTP transport execution boundary
results.detail: HTTP transport and response-envelope handling remain runtime concerns, not upstream semantic reasoning.

results.name: Laravel source and frontend target remain in end-to-end trace scope
results.detail: Source ecosystem and target example remain present for end-to-end semantic trace.

results.name: audit registration preserves package version and build command
results.detail: The focused audit is registered without changing package version or build command.

validationBoundary: Static source audit only; TypeScript build and runtime tests require installed dependencies.
